ticTacToe_short: X or O? Make your move.
ticTacToe_description: A classic 3x3 strategy game where two players take turns placing Xs and Os. Get three in a row before your opponent and claim victory!
ticTacToe_rules: The game is played on a 3x3 grid. Two players take turns, one plays X, and the other plays O. On your turn, tap an empty cell to place your symbol. The goal is to get three of your symbols in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. The first player to line up three wins the round. If all nine cells are filled and no one has three in a row, the game ends in a draw.
sudoku_description: Sudoku is a logic puzzle where you fill a 9×9 grid so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the numbers 1–9 without repetition.
sudoku_rules: Fill the 9×9 grid with numbers from 1 to 9. Each row must contain all digits from 1 to 9 with no repeats. Each column must contain all digits from 1 to 9 with no repeats. Each 3×3 box must also contain all digits from 1 to 9 with no repeats. Use logic, no guessing.
memoryGame_description: Memory is a fun card-matching game where you flip two cards at a time to find pairs. The goal is to remember the positions of all cards and match all pairs using your memory skills.
memoryGame_rules: Shuffle all the cards and lay them face down in a grid. On your turn, flip over two cards. If the cards match, they stay face up. If they do not match, flip them back face down. Keep flipping cards and using your memory to match all pairs. The game ends when all pairs have been found.
